test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Holiday homework / are essential to keeping / students busy / during the vacation.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'are essential to keeping'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'is essential to keep'** should be used instead of 'are essential to keeping&
